# Immutable v0.6.47.2 qualification reference

This directory is the frozen all-C++ production-promotion target for the
`helike_type69_mg11_ne1e8` case.  Files copied from the original
`python_xstar_tools_benchmark_v0472.tar.gz` archive are retained byte-for-byte.
The trajectory, radiation, parameters, and terminal-state inputs are included
so every future native release is compared against the same inputs and science
products.

`reference_manifest.json` and `SHA256SUMS` are authoritative.  The bundle is
qualification-only and must never be rewritten by a physics implementation.
Create a new reference schema instead of changing these bytes.
